title: Action type declaration
description: An entry in world-manifest.action_schemas (spec/loop/actions, spec/loop/preemption, spec/loop/command-channels).

type.description: Action type name, unique per world.

params_schema.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 for params (AWP-MAN-002). Local $refs resolve against the manifest's $defs.

preemption.description: Declared policies the submitter may choose from (AWP-PRE-001).

concurrency_group.description: Types sharing a group preempt one another (AWP-PRE-006).

max_queue.description: Queue depth when queue is offered (AWP-PRE-002).

command_channel.description: Command channel this streaming type opens (AWP-CMD-002).

max_abort_ms.description: Upper bound on the cancelling state for this type (AWP-LIF-010).

max_duration_ms.description: Extended types: longest execution the world permits; applies as a deadline when the submission's deadline_ms is absent or longer (AWP-ACT-008). Required for extended types in the robotics profile (AWP-ROB-007).
